promotionRules: Do not change catalog content, IDs, schemas or persistence formats after manual acceptance unless a release blocker is found.
Final promotion changes the application from 1.0.0-rc.27 to 1.0.0 and records manual acceptance; it does not regenerate the V1 catalog.
The v1-freeze-epoch-1 destructive reset is the final pre-V1 reset boundary and must not be incremented during stable promotion.
Any blocker that requires data/schema changes returns the candidate to Step 3 validation before stable promotion.
